import paddle.nn.functional as F

        # Main pathway: 1x1 convolution
        self.conv1x1_main = nn.Conv2D(
            in_channels=3,
            out_channels=64,
            kernel_size=1,
            stride=1,
            padding=0
        )

        # Parallel branch: 1x1, 1x3, and 3x1 convolutions
        self.conv1x1_branch = nn.Conv2D(
            in_channels=3,
            out_channels=64,
            kernel_size=1,
            stride=1,
            padding=0
        )
        self.conv1x3_branch = nn.Conv2D(
            in_channels=64,
            out_channels=64,
            kernel_size=(1, 3),
            stride=1,
            padding=(0, 1)
        )
        self.conv3x1_branch = nn.Conv2D(
            in_channels=64,
            out_channels=64,
            kernel_size=(3, 1),
            stride=1,
            padding=(1, 0)
        )

        # Concatenation and another 1x1 convolution
        self.conv1x1_fusion = nn.Conv2D(
            in_channels=128,
            out_channels=64,
            kernel_size=1,
            stride=1,
            padding=0
        )

        self.skip_connection = nn.Conv2D(
            in_channels=3,
            out_channels=64,
            kernel_size=1,
            stride=1,
            padding=0
        )

        self.fc1 = nn.Linear(in_features=64 * 32 * 32, out_features=512)
        self.fc2 = nn.Linear(in_features=512, out_features=10)

        # Parallel branch
        branch = self.conv1x1_branch(x)

        self.fc1 = nn.Linear(in_features=64 * 32 * 32, out_features=512)
        self.fc2 = nn.Linear(in_features=512, out_features=10)

    def forward(self, x):
        # Main pathway
        main_path = self.conv1x1_main(x)

        # Parallel branch
        branch = self.conv1x1_branch(x)
